label: Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility scope: filer-level universal and legal-zero authorities for 2025

fact_types.title: Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no Form 2555 (foreign earned income exclusion) is filed (i1040gi.pdf p.98, "Exception. Use Pub. 970 instead...if you file Form 2555"). Minted new, SLI-scoped -- not a reuse of tax.us.2025.ss-benefits-scope.no-form-2555, whose declared authority scope is the bounded Social Security Benefits Worksheet claim only (ADR-0016 decision 2 forbids cross-worksheet reuse of a scope-declared absence witness). Filer-level, not per-statement. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no Form 4563 (bona fide resident of American Samoa income exclusion) is filed (i1040gi.pdf p.98, same Exception clause as Form 2555). Minted new, SLI-scoped -- not a reuse of tax.us.2025.ss-benefits-scope.no-form-4563 (scope-mismatch, ADR-0016 decision 2). Filer-level, not per-statement. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no income is excluded as a bona fide resident of Puerto Rico or American Samoa (i1040gi.pdf p.98, same Exception clause). Minted new, SLI-scoped -- not a reuse of tax.us.2025.ss-benefits-scope.no-puerto-rico-or-samoa-income (scope-mismatch, ADR-0016 decision 2). Filer-level, not per-statement. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component (legal zero, not a block): neither the filer nor, on a joint return, the filer's spouse is claimed as a dependent on another taxpayer's 2025 return (Form 1040 instructions, Schedule 1 line 21: "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's ... 2025 tax return"; Pub. 970 p.33). An actual claim, not whether someone could claim. Filer-level. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts neither is claimed and the route proceeds; no asserts the filer or, on a joint return, the spouse IS claimed -- the law's own definite $0 for this return, not missing information and not a block.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component (legal zero, not a block): the filer is legally obligated to pay interest on the loan(s) claimed (Pub. 970 p.33: only the person legally obligated may deduct). Filer-level. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the filer is legally obligated and the route proceeds; no asserts the filer is not legally obligated -- a definite $0 for this return (someone else, not this return, may deduct it), not a block.
